synthetic_glav_core.description: Reduced-scale GLAV-style appearance variation benchmark with the paper's main quality and decoupled-rendering constraint metrics. Paper reference values are from the GLAV Table 1 3DGS and DAVIGS rows, except lpips_proxy uses the paper's LPIPS scale as the closest reported perceptual target.

ssim.description: Mean structural similarity on held-out right-half renders.

lpips_proxy.description: Deterministic perceptual proxy combining pixel and gradient errors.

worst_view_psnr.description: Minimum per-view PSNR, penalizing methods that sacrifice one held-out appearance.

mean_color_bias_mae.description: Mean absolute RGB-channel bias, catching global appearance shortcuts.

edge_mae.description: Sobel-edge mean absolute error, catching structural blur or texture shortcuts.

coupled_appearance_at_splat_render.description: Constraint flag for methods that couple appearance correction directly into splat rendering.

train_iterations.description: Optimization-step count used to discourage gains that only spend a larger training budget.

synthetic_glav_ablation.description: Reduced-scale counterpart of the paper's Table 4 ablations for 3D-aware information and identity transformation regularization.

psnr.description: Mean held-out right-half reconstruction fidelity for component comparisons.

ssim.description: Mean structural similarity for component comparisons.

lpips_proxy.description: Deterministic perceptual proxy for component comparisons.

worst_view_psnr.description: Minimum per-view PSNR, checking that component changes do not collapse one held-out view.

mean_color_bias_mae.description: Mean absolute RGB-channel bias for the ablated method outputs.

edge_mae.description: Sobel-edge mean absolute error for the ablated method outputs.

uses_3d_hash_features.description: Component flag indicating use of 3D-aware local features.

uses_identity_regularizer.description: Component flag indicating use of the identity transformation regularizer.
